area: Live motion: ZPA analysis, Traffic insights, Live DLP feed, Bypass report
title: Moving flows on four report pages, drawn on the Flow animator engine from each page's own result

checks.what: ZPA connections flow draws the map's own IdPs, connector groups and app segments; down and outdated connector counts equal the overview KPIs
Links to a connector group whose App Connectors are all down stop; one with a connector down or outdated flickers; a healthy tenant shows neither

Diagnosis walk visits segment, segment group, every evaluated access rule in order with why, the deciding rule, server groups, App Connectors; stops on deny, default deny, bypass, no segment and nothing serving
Traffic insights streams equal the location, action, firewall and application numbers; gaps between tables drawn and named, never spread
Each landed incident flies channel, dictionaries, engine, rule, configured action, incident receiver; the words name no user or file
Bypass streams equal the report's counts and add up to its total; ZPA bypass and PAC DIRECT drawn as not measured; out-of-scope sections as not read
Each picture moves, pauses by keyboard (Shift+Tab to the toggle, Enter), is still under prefers-reduced-motion until Play, and has a text alternative
No horizontal page scroll at 320 and 390 px with each picture drawn, in both motion modes
The page motion code has no HTML sink: tenant strings reach the page as text nodes; the XSS sink scan passes
One engine: flow_pages.js has no clock of its own (FA.animator, paused while the tab is hidden) and no external script
